The details, made clear

Privacy policy.

How Nibbly handles game progress, optional purchases, and the messages you choose to send.

About Nibbly

Nibbly is a puzzle game for children and adults. There are no advertisements, chat, public profiles, or account registration. A grown-up should manage purchases and contact support.

Progress and custom levels

Progress, settings, replays and custom puzzles are stored on your device. We do not upload them to a game server. Android may include app data in device backups according to your system settings. Import and export operate on files you choose. If you share a file through another app, that app's privacy practices apply.

Optional purchases

The first 20 levels can be played without enabling purchase services. A grown-up check appears before purchase options, restoration or support email. Enabling purchase options allows Google Play and RevenueCat to process purchase history and check purchase access on subsequent launches on this device.

Google Play processes payments; Nibbly does not receive payment-card details. RevenueCat processes receipts, purchase status, a randomly generated app-user identifier and technical app/platform information to verify purchases, restore access and prevent fraud. Purchase services receive network information such as an IP address when contacted. We do not supply a player's name, email address, age, advertising identifier or contacts to RevenueCat.

There are no advertising or attribution integrations. Purchase records are retained as needed to maintain access, support restoration, prevent fraud and meet applicable recordkeeping requirements. Google Play and RevenueCat maintain their service records under their policies: Google Privacy Policy and RevenueCat Privacy Policy.

Children and grown-ups

Children can play without providing a name, email address or birthday. Parents or guardians should manage purchases and email. The grown-up check is an interaction safeguard, not identity verification. Parents should review the purchase-service information before enabling it. Please do not send children's personal information in support messages.

Contacting support

Contact us opens an editable email draft. It includes the game version, platform, build and selected level, plus an optional name field. Nothing is sent automatically. If you send it, we receive your sender address and the details you include, and use them to respond. Messages are retained only as needed for support and applicable recordkeeping.

Your choices

Clear local game data through Android settings to remove local progress and custom levels. Purchase access can be restored with the Google Play account that bought it. For privacy questions, access or deletion requests, a parent or player can contact tidhar.peer@gmail.com. Do not include payment-card information. Purchase refunds are handled through Google Play. Personal data is not sold or used for targeted advertising.

Policy updates

This policy will be updated when the game's data practices change. The date above identifies this version.
